verdict.rationale: Intuit documents a QuickBooks Online V3 REST API with official SDKs and an official MCP server that exposes 11 financial reports (Balance Sheet, P&L, Cash Flow, and more), so programmatic report access exists. Nothing in the evidence names the General Ledger or Trial Balance among those reports, the export formats are never stated, and probes found no published OpenAPI spec. Missing for 10: explicit evidence of General Ledger and Trial Balance report endpoints, documentation of open output formats (e.g. JSON/CSV), a machine-readable API spec, and independent hands-on corroboration of pulling full ledger data.
